items.title: ARC Prize verifies Gemini 4 Carbon on ARC-AGI-1/2/3
items.summary: ARC Prize published verified Gemini 4 Carbon scores (ARC-AGI-3 99.1% with a provider adapter, 65.1% on the standard harness; ARC-AGI-2 94.2%; ARC-AGI-1 98.5%) and per-task cost and reasoning-token comparisons against its predecessor Argon.

items.title: LTX-2.5 VFX tools (AlphaGen, Reframe, Upscale, SDR to HDR) live on fal
items.summary: fal added four LTX-2.5 video tools: alpha matte generation up to 4K, aspect-ratio reframing, upscaling to 4K or 8K, and SDR to HDR conversion, each with a hosted endpoint.

items.title: Hermes Roam plugin syncs Hermes agent memory, skills and config across devices
items.summary: A hackathon entry now in the official Hermes plugin catalog that pushes and pulls an agent's soul, memories, skills and config between devices. Built by the author for Hermes Agent users.

doubt.pushback: No repo or catalog link in the post, only a demo video, so nothing to check from the post alone.

items.title: Letta FrontierMemory: Fable 5.2 ties Opus 5.5 for first, at about 2x dream cost
items.summary: Letta's FrontierMemory leaderboard shows Claude Fable 5.2 tying Opus 5.5 overall and beating it at lower effort levels on generated memory quality, at roughly $600 per dream versus $300.
